title: Billing Incident SOP v2
content:
## Billing Incident SOP v2

Version: 2.0 (Current — replaces v1)
Effective: 2026-04-01

### Escalation Trigger
When 3 or more tickets from distinct reporters identify the same billing cluster failure within a 4-hour window, treat this as a billing incident. NOTE: The threshold has been raised from 2 to 3 to reduce false-positive escalations.

### Required Actions
1. Read all open billing tickets and identify the cluster name.
2. Tag each incident ticket with: incident-core, billing-sla-breach
3. Set priority=critical on all cluster incident tickets. (Changed from 'high' in v1.)
4. Set category=incident-billing on all cluster incident tickets. (Changed from 'incident' in v1.)
5. Do NOT close any ticket — leave resolution to the on-call billing engineer.
6. Output one line per updated ticket: TICKET_ID|priority|category|why

### Threshold
- Minimum 3 tickets from distinct reporters pointing to the same cluster = escalation required.
- Groups of only 2 tickets do NOT meet the v2 threshold and should NOT be escalated.
- Single-reporter tickets do not trigger escalation unless confirmed by additional reporters.

### Exclusions
- UI bugs, slow performance on non-cluster services, document requests, access requests, and routine report requests are NOT billing incidents.
- Do not apply incident labels to tickets that describe separate root causes.
- Do not use v1 labels (priority=high, category=incident) — they are deprecated.

title: Policy Update: Billing Incident SOP v1 Deprecated
content:
## Policy Update Notice

Date: 2026-04-01

### Action Required
The Billing Incident SOP v1 is now DEPRECATED and must no longer be used.

Effective immediately, all billing incident triage must follow Billing Incident SOP v2 (article: kb_f02_billing_sop_v2).

### Key Changes Summary
| Field | v1 (Deprecated) | v2 (Current) |
|---|---|---|
| Escalation threshold | 2+ tickets | 3+ tickets |
| Priority label | high | critical |
| Category label | incident | incident-billing |
| Required tags | incident-core | incident-core, billing-sla-breach |

### Reason for Change
The v1 threshold of 2 tickets generated too many false-positive escalations for transient billing errors that self-resolved. The v2 threshold of 3 tickets ensures only confirmed, multi-team cluster failures are escalated to the on-call rotation.

Any saved procedures, runbooks, or skill artifacts referencing the v1 rules must be updated to v2 immediately.
